chargeprice-revanced.description: Chargeprice Morphe builds upon the original Chargeprice app, a comprehensive EV charging map for Europe that compares prices from hundreds of providers to help users find the best rates for AC/DC stations. This modification applies a custom 'Unlock Premium' patch from community forks like brosssh/revanced-patches, compatible with the package fr.chargeprice.app, to bypass subscription costs and enable full premium access without specific version requirements.
